method: Read-only weekly digest. Per client, metrics are SUM(public.daily_analytics_snapshots) over the report week, tenant-wide (all seats). Baseline = trailing 4-week average over weeks with activity; the trend sparkline covers 8 weeks. A metric is red-flagged when it moves ≥ 30% in the unhealthy direction (down: sends/replies/positive/meetings/revenue; up: negative/blocked), above a min-volume floor (baseline ≥ 10 sends / ≥ 3 replies), or drops to zero after prior activity. Clients with < 2 active baseline weeks render without flags (“new”); clients with no active campaign and no current sends are shown as “dormant”, not flagged. Per-campaign breakdowns use campaign names from revhero_prod_campaign. Snapshot rows are sparse; a global day-coverage guard suppresses all flags if the report week looks like a pipeline gap.
